verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented per-account or per-program transaction or velocity limits, no suspicious-activity holds, and no account freeze or reinstatement workflow. What exists is adjacent: Account holds reserve funds for known future activity (not risk holds), transfers can wait for a team member's approval, and real-time card authorization webhooks are developer building blocks for writing your own limit logic. None of these count as the story's capability under the partial-credit boundary.
